sources.title: emotionclassifier · PyPI
sources.snippet: emotionclassifier is a Python package designed to classify emotions in text using various pre-trained models from Hugging Face's Transformers library. This package provides a user-friendly interface for emotion classification, along with tools for data preprocessing, visualization, fine-tuning, and integration with popular data platforms.
